ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported
SoC= Standard of Care, Control Group; PRT= Progressive Ratio Training, Experimental Group

ElementDescription: Experimental condition in effect during the behavioral observation
Notes: BL = Baseline; DRA/EXT = Differential Reinforcement of Alternative Behavior with Extinction; PRT = Progressive Ratio Training; Test 1 = Response-Dependent Reinstatement Test; Test 2 = Response-Independent Reinstatement Test

ElementDescription: Duration of the behavioral session in seconds.
Notes: Session duration converted to seconds; preserves shortened/nonstandard session durations.

ElementDescription: Rate of the target response during the session, expressed as responses per minute.
Notes: Participant-specific target response; rates are per minute.

ElementDescription: Rate of the alternative response during the session, expressed as responses per minute.
Notes: Participant-specific alternative response; rates are per minute.
